proposal.reason: This is the highest-information first ARIA trial: it tests the validated official model family and full input protocol against the weak fixed baseline. It changes model family and feature protocol together, so any gain will be attributed to the bundled transition rather than a single mechanism.
proposal.hypothesis: The official full-input XGBoost default will improve validation AUPRC by at least 0.20 absolute over the metadata-only logistic baseline by capturing nonlinear interactions across the complete leakage-safe feature set.
proposal.observation: The fixed metadata-only logistic baseline achieved validation AUPRC 0.18417067640399878 on 2019 validation data, with 269 false negatives and 638 false positives at its best-F1 threshold.
proposal.expected_result: Validation AUPRC >= 0.3841706764; otherwise reject the model-family/full-feature transition as insufficient under this fixed protocol.

previous_decision.reason: The baseline validation AUPRC of 0.18417067640399878 is too low to retain when two bounded ARIA trials remain.
previous_decision.learning: Metadata-only linear effects are an inadequate ranking model for this validation protocol.
previous_decision.next_question: Does the official full-input XGBoost default produce the expected large ranking improvement?
